routes.name: Goûter Route
routes.description: The voie normale from the Nid d'Aigle, over the Tête Rousse and Goûter huts, across the Dôme du Goûter and up the Bosses ridge to the summit.

trips.title: Mont Blanc — Goûter route
trips.notes: Left the Goûter at 02:30 with a hard freeze. Bosses ridge in good condition, wind picked up above Vallot.
